block.title: Square pixel sprite sheet: cone battery sizes, wisp swarm set, molten shot and slag effects on flat navy
block.positive: SNES-era 16-bit pixel art, flat colored pixel sprites with bold dark navy outlines and simple two-tone dithered shading, arranged as a square sprite sheet grid on a completely flat deep-navy background, no scenery, no text, no labels, no UI. Top row — three MAGMA CONE turrets in ascending size (small sentry cone, standard cone, heavy cone with an extra rock terrace), each a stack of black basalt plates with glowing lava seams, craters facing left, plus one heavy cone with its plates burst open and cherry-hot. Second row — a swarm set of EMBER WISPS: five flame bodies of irregular silhouette around molten-gold cores, two wisp pairs mid-fission stretching apart, and one wisp burning out to a gray ash puff with a last gold spark. Third row — molten projectiles in left-facing flight: single round shots with bright cores and dark rims in red and pink, pairs, a three-shot fan, and a slow lobbed glob of lava with a dripping gold tail. Fourth row — environmental pixels: stalactite slag tips with glow beads, a cracked basalt plate tile, a lava-surface patch of the dark-ember-to-tangerine ramp, two falling droplet sprites, and a small crater-scorch ground decal. Chunky arcade silhouettes, saturated limited palette, crisp pixel-grid edges, every sprite facing left.
